## Age-based vaccine efficacy

This graph shows a simple efficacy proxy, estimated from the share of participants reporting no symptoms in the daily survey after vaccination, grouped by age band.

### Equation shown on the graph

$$
E(age) = 100 \times P(\text{symptom-free} \mid age)
$$

![Age-based vaccine efficacy proxy](images/age_efficacy.png)

### Notes

- The chart uses a symptom-free rate proxy as a practical estimate of vaccine efficacy by age group.
- Lower symptom-free shares in younger adult groups suggest a weaker protective signal in this simplified proxy.
- The graph is intended as a starting point for further age-stratified analysis.
